caption: A new record saved with a made up username and an empty password field. The interface was in Dutch, and Privé means the record starts out private. The account e-mail is hidden.
Our test team Marketing (test) in multi admin mode, with view only as the default right for members. The owner and account e-mails are hidden.
Sharing a record takes two steps: switch its mode to sharing with multi admin teams, then turn on the toggle per team. Here the toggle for our test team is still off. The account e-mail is hidden.
Passpack asks for confirmation before the record becomes manageable by all admins of the organisation. The account e-mail is hidden.
The subscription page shows the Business plan on Trial, renewing by the number of licences in use, now 1. No card was asked for the trial and no price appears here. The account e-mail is hidden.
